styleLock.direction: tech-editorial oral-care commerce on flat color fields
styleLock.backgroundSystem: only three flat seamless grounds across the set: #FFFFFF for the packshot and the mechanism screen, #CFE0D4 for benefit, comparison, variant and close screens, #2A2C2E for macro, pain-point and spec screens; no gradients, no arches, no cut-paper shapes
styleLock.lightingSystem: even soft studio key from the upper left with a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow grounding every product; raking side light reserved for macro screens; hard low-key only on the pain-point screen
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte #CFE0D4 counter band and slim #F6C766 circular discs are the only staging surfaces, no glossy podiums and no unlisted props
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only; headline 28-36pt in #2A2C2E on light grounds, in #CFE0D4 or #F6C766 on #2A2C2E grounds; labels 14-16pt; one idea per screen, no dense body paragraphs
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line icons in #2A2C2E on light grounds and in #F6C766 on #2A2C2E grounds, plus solid #F6C766 numbered discs for steps and mode lists
styleLock.presentationRules: product stays upright at a stable slight 3/4 hero angle with consistent scale across screens, identical crop and light inside comparison and variant grids, contact shadow always present, no product redesign
noDrift: no color palette changes beyond #FFFFFF, #CFE0D4, #2A2C2E and #F6C766
no gradients, no cut-paper arch shapes, no extra decorative geometry
no mixed fonts and no dense body text
no inconsistent lighting or drifting product scale between shots
no mismatched icon styles between screens
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent tech-editorial oral-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of flat #FFFFFF packshot ground, flat #CFE0D4 info ground, flat #2A2C2E macro and spec ground, and one marigold accent #F6C766; neutral color temperature; modern geometric sans-serif with headline in #2A2C2E on light grounds and in #CFE0D4 or #F6C766 on #2A2C2E grounds; three flat seamless background grounds only, no gradients and no cut-paper arches; even soft studio key from the upper left with a fill card on the shadow side and a soft contact shadow grounding every product; single-weight thin-line icons with solid #F6C766 numbered discs; rounded cards, hairline dividers, one idea per screen; stable upright slight 3/4 hero angle and stable product scale, no product redesign; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 源为 9 屏口腔护理电动牙刷爆款详情页切图，逐屏识图后合并重复角色：模式清单两屏合为一张宫格图，续航与防水两屏合为一张规格卡，两屏近重复的防水卡片丢弃其一。已剥离：原品牌与店铺字样、引流角标与二维码、第三方权威口吻的提示语、源图全部中文标题与独特排版（撕纸圆弧拼贴、六宫格图标墙、纯色大圆盘清单、灰底线稿手部步骤图），以及刷头振频、清洁倍率、防水等级、工作分贝、摆动幅度、充电时长、续航天数、定时提醒秒数等具体数值与资质表述，上述信息一律改写为 selling_point 与 callout 占位。源图对可用模式数量前后不一致，故模版不写死数量。产品始终以 product 占位，可套用到任意同类声波电动牙刷。
